headlines.title: 韩国将暂停新的单一股票杠杆ETF上市 以抑制市场波动
headlines.summary: 韩国将暂停新的单一股票杠杆交易所交易产品上市，以抑制市场波动。此前与三星电子和SK海力士挂钩的杠杆基金需求激增。韩国金融服务委员会周四发表声明称，该禁令将持续有效，直至市场状况稳定。此外，当局还将自8月5日起把杠杆ETF的最低保证金从1000万韩元提高至3000万韩元（20300美元）。该决定是在监管机构、财政部和央行官员举行会议之后做出的，要求决策者抑制规模4.1万亿美元股票市场波动的呼声增强。许多市场参与者认为，两个月前推出的十多只杠杆ETF加剧了市场波动。由于需要保持目标杠杆水平，这类产品需要每日进行大量资金再平衡。

headlines.title_en: South Korea to suspend new single-stock leveraged ETF listings to curb market volatility
headlines.summary_en: South Korea will suspend the listing of new single-stock leveraged exchange-traded products to curb market volatility, following surging demand for leveraged funds linked to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The Financial Services Commission said in a statement on Thursday that the ban will remain in effect until market conditions stabilize. Additionally, authorities will raise the minimum margin for leveraged ETFs from 10 million won to 30 million won ($20,300) starting August 5. The decision was made after a meeting of regulators, the finance ministry, and central bank officials, amid growing calls for policymakers to curb volatility in the $4.1 trillion stock market. Many market participants believe that over a dozen leveraged ETFs launched two months ago have exacerbated fluctuations, as these products require daily large-scale rebalancing to maintain target leverage levels.

headlines.title: 财政部公布2026年中央财政支持普惠金融发展示范区名单等有关事项
headlines.summary: 其中提到，强化财政金融工作协同。省级财政部门要加强与中国人民银行分支机构、金融监管总局派出机构、地方金融管理机构及相关金融机构的协同联动，指导普惠金融发展示范区统筹用好中央奖补资金，提高贷款贴息、融资担保、风险补偿、资本金补充等工作质效，与财政金融协同促内需一揽子政策做好适配，强化效能叠加；普惠金融发展示范区财政部门要聚焦民间投资、科技创新、居民消费等重点领域，加大小微企业融资支持力度，助力扩投资、促消费、稳就业，引导更多金融资源和社会资本投入普惠金融发展示范区建设。（财政部网站）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance publishes list of 2026 central financial support for inclusive finance development demonstration zones and related matters
headlines.summary_en: It mentions strengthening coordination between fiscal and financial work. Provincial finance departments should enhance collaboration with PBOC branches, NFRA local offices, local financial regulatory bodies, and related financial institutions, guiding inclusive finance development demonstration zones to make coordinated use of central reward funds, improving the quality and efficiency of loan interest subsidies, financing guarantees, risk compensation, and capital replenishment, aligning with the package of fiscal and financial policies to boost domestic demand and amplifying synergy. Finance departments in inclusive finance development demonstration zones should focus on key areas such as private investment, technological innovation, and household consumption, increasing financing support for small and micro enterprises, aiding in expanding investment, boosting consumption, and stabilizing employment, guiding more financial resources and social capital into the construction of inclusive finance development demonstration zones. (Ministry of Finance website)

headlines.title: 英国经济实现增长 服务业无视能源和政治动荡
headlines.summary: 英国经济5月意外实现了增长，这表明面对政治动荡和能源价格上涨，消费者和企业的韧性比预期的更强。 英国国家统计局周四表示，5月份国内生产总值上升了0.1%，4月份曾下降0.1%。经济学家此前预计该数据将持平。受医疗科学研发领域以及零售业表现强劲的推动，5月服务业环比增长0.3%，温暖的天气促使消费者前往商店购物。与此同时，建筑业下降0.8%，工业生产下降0.5%，原因是制造业的小幅增长被能源和公用事业产出的下降所抵消。在经济夹在政治风波和能源危机之间的背景下，整体经济出现了温和改善。

headlines.title_en: UK economy grows as services sector defies energy and political turmoil
headlines.summary_en: The UK economy unexpectedly grew in May, showing that consumers and businesses were more resilient than expected amid political turmoil and energy price rises. The Office for National Statistics said on Thursday that GDP rose 0.1% in May, after a 0.1% decline in April. Economists had expected the data to be flat. The services sector grew 0.3% month-on-month in May, driven by strong performance in medical science R&D and retail, with warm weather prompting consumers to visit shops. Meanwhile, construction fell 0.8%, and industrial production fell 0.5%, as a small increase in manufacturing was offset by a decline in energy and utility output. The overall economy showed a moderate improvement amid political shocks and an energy crisis.

headlines.title: 百度申请香港、纳斯达克双重主要上市，或赶上9月港股通窗口

headlines.title_en: Baidu applies for dual primary listing in Hong Kong and Nasdaq, potentially catching September Stock Connect window
headlines.summary_en: On July 16, Baidu Group announced that its board of directors has authorized management to proceed with a voluntary conversion to primary listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange main board, expected to take effect this year. After the process is completed, Baidu will achieve dual primary listings in Hong Kong and on the Nasdaq. The announcement stated that once effective, the dual primary listing will enhance the liquidity of the company's securities, expand its investor base, and provide greater flexibility in accessing both capital markets.

headlines.title: 商务部：将根据国内外氦气供需变化适时调整出口管理
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东在16日举行的商务部例行新闻发布会上回应我国对氦气进行临时禁止出口管理的有关提问时说，中国是氦气主要进口国，为保障国内供应，商务部、海关总署联合发布公告，决定对氦气实施临时禁止出口管理。该举措符合《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》有关规定和世贸组织规则。后续，我们将根据国内外氦气供需变化，适时调整出口管理政策。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: will adjust helium export management based on changes in domestic and foreign supply and demand
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong, at a regular press conference on July 16, responded to questions about China's temporary ban on helium exports, saying China is a major helium importer. To ensure domestic supply, the Ministry of Commerce and the General Administration of Customs jointly issued an announcement deciding to temporarily prohibit helium exports. This measure complies with the Foreign Trade Law and WTO rules. Going forward, we will adjust the export management policy in a timely manner based on changes in domestic and international helium supply and demand. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: Crude oil LOF E Fund warns of premium risk in secondary market
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data July 16, E Fund Management Co., Ltd. announced that the secondary market trading price of its E Fund Crude Oil Securities Investment Fund (QDII) Class A RMB Shares (ticker: Crude Oil LOF E Fund; fund code: 161129) is significantly higher than the fund's net asset value per share, showing a large premium. On July 16, 2026, the closing price of the fund on the secondary market was 1.756 yuan, while the fund's net asset value per share as of July 14, 2026, was 1.5886 yuan. Investors are hereby earnestly reminded to closely monitor the premium risk in secondary market trading prices, make investment decisions prudently, and may suffer substantial losses if investing blindly.

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: ChiNext Index fluctuates down nearly 3%; chip and computing power hardware stocks collectively adjust
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market saw a full-day adjustment, with all three major indices falling. Film and television stocks rose sharply, with Ruyi Film (HKG: after removing cross-market, unclear ticker) hitting the 2-board limit, and Shanghai Film (601595) and Huanrui Century (000892) hitting limit up. Pharmaceutical stocks continued to rebound, with Harbin Pharmaceutical (600664) hitting 5 consecutive limit ups, and Pian Zai Huang (600436) and Hainan Haiyao (000566) among limit ups. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks adjusted, with GigaDevice, JCET (600584), and Demili (300245) among many hitting limit down; computing hardware stocks weakened, with HGLaser (000988), China Jushi (600176), and Sinoma Science & Technology (002080) hitting limit down. More stocks fell than rose, with about 2900 stocks declining across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing, with today's turnover at 2.42 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.85%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.97%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.95%. 2. By sector concept, film and TV short dramas, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, pork, and tourism led gains, while semiconductor chips, computing hardware, oil and gas, and coal led losses. 3. A total of 2344 stocks rose across两市, with 46 stocks up.

headlines.title: China’s second-quarter GDP growth misses mark, with lowest reading since end of 2022
headlines.summary:
China reported 4.3 per cent gross domestic product growth in the second quarter of 2026 shortly after recording strong, sustained momentum in exports – a contrast underscoring the need for policy support to address weak domestic demand and persistent economic imbalances.
The closely watched GDP figure, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday, was the slowest quarterly growth rate since the end of 2022. The number fell below the 4.48 per cent forecast from economists...

headlines.title: 商务部回应推动解决安世半导体问题进展
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东在16日举行的商务部例行新闻发布会上回应推动解决安世半导体进展的有关提问时说，中荷建立开放务实的全面合作伙伴关系10多年来，双边经贸合作不断深化。7月7日，荷兰外贸与发展合作大臣舍尔茨玛访华，王文涛部长与其共同主持召开中荷经贸混委会第18次会议，就中荷、中欧经贸关系坦诚、深入交换意见。中荷双方同意，双方政府应创造良好环境，推动企业通过协商化解纠纷，保障全球半导体产供链安全稳定。(新华社)

headlines.title_en: Commerce Ministry Responds on Progress in Resolving Nexperia Semiconductor Issues
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong, at a regular press conference on July 16, responded to questions about progress in resolving the Nexperia Semiconductor issue, saying that since establishing an open and pragmatic comprehensive partnership over 10 years ago, bilateral economic and trade cooperation has deepened. On July 7, Dutch Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation Reinette Klever visited China, and Minister Wang Wentao co-chaired the 18th China-Netherlands Economic and Trade Joint Committee meeting, conducting frank and in-depth exchanges on China-Netherlands and China-EU economic ties. Both sides agreed that governments should create a favorable environment and promote enterprise negotiation to resolve disputes, ensuring the security and stability of the global semiconductor supply chain. (Xinhua News Agency)
